function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

message.reasoning: The user asks: "目前最受歡迎的流行歌曲是什麼？還請幫我找出澳洲目前最受歡迎的搖滾歌曲。" They want the most popular pop song currently (no region specified, so maybe global). And also find the most popular rock song in Australia. We need to use the function to get the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region. For the first request, no region specified; we can assume global or default region? The function requires region. We could set region to "global" or "world". But the function expects a region string. We can pass region: "global" or "world". The user didn't specify region for pop. So we can interpret as global. For the second request, region: "Australia" or "Australia" or "AU". The function signature: genre: string, region: string, duration?: number. We'll call twice: first for pop global, second for rock Australia. We'll set duration default. We'll call function twice.
